content.what_it_is: MATLAB plotting script that defines five grid spacings and setup values (L1-L2), forms a negated sample-index gradient (L3), and log-log plots that result against grid spacing with setup-difference labeling (L4-L9).

equations.ref: negated gradient with implicit unit sample spacing

unresolved: Cross-line quantity mismatch across L1,L3,L5,L9: dx is nonuniform (successive doubling), but gradient is called without dx and therefore differentiates with respect to unit sample index; the resulting endpoint/central differences are then plotted against dx and labeled as a setup difference, not as an index-gradient or a derivative with respect to grid spacing.
No reference value or selected convergence-order fit is defined, so the plotted hmg cannot by itself distinguish consecutive-resolution differences from error relative to a converged solution.
